# Artifact Center · 产物中心
Find the file a DSH conversation produced, together with its workspace and conversation history.
中文说明 · Requirements · Acceptance record · MIT
## Features

- A global sidebar panel that works without an active conversation.
- Historical backfill from compl

ete session events, including file writes, edits and explicitly presented deliverables.
- Live works
pace snapshots at turn end to detect shell and subprocess outputs. Large output bursts are summarize

d rather than flooding the list.
- Workspace/tag/date filters, favorites, notes, bounded text-conten
t search and a virtualized list. Check or uncheck extensions directly under “Readable formats” to co

ntrol visibility; the choice is saved in this browser.
- Native image, PDF, Markdown, Mermaid, text/
code, CSV/TSV, sandboxed HTML and media previews. Office files and binaries use the system's applica

tions; no format conversion takes place.
- Conversation links, path/link copying, file-handler selec

tion, provenance history and CSV/Markdown export.
- Missing-file checks and confirmed moves to the s
ystem trash. Retrieve a file using your file manager, then check files to restore its index status.
- A read-only `artifact_search` Agent tool and Chinese/English UI.
History records provenance and metadata; it **does not preserve old file contents**. Snapshot result
s are labeled as inferred because filesystem changes cannot prove which concurrent task caused them.
Historical shell outputs that have no recorded path cannot be reconstructed from current files alon
e. Starting with 0.1.2, a separate provenance table preserves recorded outputs and annotations when
the derived list cache is rebuilt. Persisted turn checkpoints survive restarts; completed turns are
recovered without including files modified after their recorded end time. Removing the entire storag
e domain also removes provenance and annotations. `enableBetterSidebar` is reserved; delegation to t
hat optional plugin is not implemented. The built-in Markdown and Mermaid renderers work independent
optional plugin is not implemented. The built-in Markdown and Mermaid renderers work independently.

Restart the Host and refresh the browser. The Electron-managed `desktop` profile must be installed t
hrough its plugin manager; do not manage it with CLI commands. Market availability depends on accept
ance of the directory entry.
## Configuration
The plugin ID is `artifact-center`. Override settings in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Automatic tag rules accept `glob`, `ext` and `session` (conversation-title substring). `readableExte
nsions` is a whitelist of extensions without the leading dot; the Artifact Center navigation shows t
he active list under “Readable formats”. An empty list uses all built-in supported formats. Files ou
tside this whitelist are not indexed or content-read. Default ignored directories: `.git`, `node_mod
ules`, `dist`, `build`, `.next`, `__pycache__`, `.venv`, `target`, `.cache`, `.dsh`. `ignorePatterns
` replaces the default list when explicitly supplied. State is held through the Host's `storageDomai
n` API under `artifact_center`.
HTTP routes under `/artifact-center/*` require the Host's browser authentication and same-origin req
uest guard. Only indexed files inside their registered workspace can be read or opened; outside syml
inks are rejected. HTML previews cannot execute scripts or access the network. Text search reads at
most `textMaxBytes` per candidate; it is not a semantic or binary-document search engine.
## Agent tool
`artifact_search(query, workspace?, type?, tag?, since?, limit?)` returns matching metadata and path
s. `workspace` accepts an ID or title; types include `doc`, `sheet`, `slide`, `image`, `web`, `data`
, `code`, `media`, `archive` and `other`. `since` is an ISO timestamp and `limit` is at most 100. Mi
ssing and trashed files remain labeled in results.
## Development
Host and UI are plain JavaScript. Only the lazy Mermaid renderer is independently bundled; no Harnes
s build preset or internal UI package is imported.
With the isolated development Host and authenticated `artifact-p0` browser running, `npm run test:ui
` checks fixture-only previews, tag errors and a 10,000-record virtual list. API writes are intercep
ted and never reach real storage or system actions. `npm run test:locale` checks the English UI and
restores the original language preference.
Search refreshes the current registered workspace boundaries before reading content. Removed workspa
ces and paths outside a workspace's changed root are excluded without deleting their recorded proven
ance. After committing the release source, pack into `.cache` and run `npm run release:check` to com
pare the archive with both the working files and Git HEAD and generate a local integrity receipt. Th
is command does not publish or authenticate.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Renderer bundles and license notices are committed and shipped, so installation does not run a compi
ler. Test probes are excluded from the npm package and load only through a separate development over
lay. Read development notes and implementation corrections before changing the integration.
The reference acceptance Host is DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`. Desktop `0.2.0` compatibility is declared in the
optional native-opener peer range, but desktop installation must also pass that Host's plugin manage
r and browser acceptance. Older sessions rejected by the Host's migration are reported individually;
their raw logs are never modified by this plugin.
